story_type: ski-equipped cargo plane lands and takes off on the Greenland ice sheet
hook: The biggest plane in the world that lands on skis.
narration: This is the biggest plane in the world that can land on skis.
It is an LC-130 from the Air National Guard's 109th Airlift Wing.
Here it was practicing takeoffs and landings at Raven Camp, out on the Greenland ice.
Wheels would sink into soft snow, so the skis spread its weight across the surface.
Four propellers throw up a storm of snow as it taxis.
outcome: Then it lifted off the ice and climbed away over Greenland.
title: Biggest plane on skis lands on the ice
description:
An LC-130H from the 109th Airlift Wing practices takeoffs and landings on skis at Raven Camp, Greenland, on Aug. 31, 2026. The LC-130 is the largest aircraft in the world that can land on snow and ice using skis.

Footage: Air National Guard video by Master Sgt. Jamie Spaulding, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1027198
